review.editorial_summary: Implemented the four GEDCOM and GEDZIP actions; audited GEDCOM 4.0.2 regrade passed 201/212 with unchanged generated source.
review.notes:
Original generation completed normally under GEDCOM 4.0.1 at 194/206. All 233 canonical items (6 messages, 177 commands, 50 file changes), command outcomes and relevant self-test outputs were reviewed. Ordinary local scratch-test mistakes and rejected cleanup attempts recovered; the final regression completed successfully. Canonical events plus the preserved richer session reproduce all token counts, reasoning tokens and underlying tool calls. API-only network audit and launch input hashes pass; hosted apps were available but no external invocation was observed, so the comparison cohort is api-proxy-apps-available-unused. The official zero-inference regrade preserves the original result and unchanged source and verified manifests. Corrected 4.0.2 scoring is 201/212: seven formerly incorrect mandatory-xref negatives now award valid unreferenced records; six focused reciprocal-link cases add genuine failures. Eleven remaining failures form three broad defect clusters, not eleven independent bugs: four GEDZIP failures omit required local FILE/archive consistency and reserved-name/file-URL restrictions (public chapter 4 and section 2.12); six inspect/render cases accept family members without the mandatory individual backlinks (section 3.2.2); and one childless empty SNOTE is accepted despite the global nonempty-payload-or-substructure rule (section 1.2). Source inspection confirms those missing checks; no unresolved fixture issue was found in these failures. Recorded usage: 32,252,026 total tokens, 142,907 reasoning tokens, 227 tool calls; estimated cost $1.047181, with no reported cost. Historic generation metadata and usage remain preserved.

Run conditions: apps available but no external tool invocation observed.
